course: 1C:Enterprise 8 Programming — from foundations to professional development
module: Platform architecture, infobases and development environments
title: Your first message: what runs 1C code
goal: Open the right module in your training infobase, display an actual message and distinguish saving, applying and restarting.

prerequisites.text: Use the separate empty base from the previous lesson. If you have not prepared it, follow the preparation block below first. No catalogs, queries or customer work are required.

sections.title: Why saved text stays silent
paragraphs: Writing “greet the visitor” in a text file does not greet anyone merely because the file is saved. Likewise, 1C source needs an execution location and moment. We will write an application-start event handler, which the platform calls when user mode starts. It is our first small automation of a familiar action.

An event is a particular point in system operation. A handler is code assigned to act at that point. Here ПриНачалеРаботыСистемы is a platform-recognised handler name. Renaming it arbitrarily is different from changing the greeting text.

sections.title: If your separate base is not ready
paragraphs: If 1C is not installed, use the official training-version page below and follow the supplier’s download, licence and installation instructions. Nexus does not distribute the platform installer. If a suitable legally installed platform already runs, you need not reinstall it. Without the platform you can read the lesson, but the practical work remains not performed, rather than becoming successful through a note.

In the 1C launcher choose Add → Create a new infobase → Without configuration for development. Select a local location, a clear name such as NexusReferenceProgramming and a new separate empty folder. Before finishing, compare it with working infobase folders: it must be different. If the folder already contains a base, cancel and choose another new folder. The list name is a convenient label; the directory identifies the storage being opened.

Select the new item and open Designer. If no configuration tree is shown, choose Configuration → Open configuration. Then open the same infobase in Enterprise mode: an empty configuration has no customer or service lists yet. That is expected. Close the user window before the next edit. Never load a training configuration over existing data. The applied 1C course separately explains loading a ready-made service; the first message does not need it.

sections.title: Open the module, not a card field
paragraphs: Close the user window for your training base. In its Designer, open configuration, then use the root tree item’s context menu → Open managed application module (sometimes Open application module). The root is the top node bearing the configuration name. Do not choose a random catalog’s object module: its execution moment differs.

In a new empty base the module is available for this experiment. If it already contains your code, save that separately first and do not insert a second procedure with the same name. For this starting route, using a separate new base is safer than rewriting an existing application. The complete module text follows.

sections.title: Three source lines and one message
paragraphs: Процедура begins the definition of a named action; КонецПроцедуры ends it. Empty parentheses after this handler name list no parameters. The inner line calls the built-in Сообщить procedure. The call’s parentheses pass an argument: a string in double quotes. The parentheses have roles determined by their respective constructs.

Сообщить displays the supplied value in the client message area. Quotes delimit a string literal and are not printed. The semicolon terminates the call statement. Indentation improves readability. Keep Процедура and Сообщить even while reading the English lesson: this route uses one verifiable source for the Russian training configuration.

code.output: In the message area: Моя учебная служба работает

sections.title: Save, apply, run
paragraphs: Press Ctrl+S in Designer, then F7 (Update database configuration), confirming the changes to your own empty training base. Then F5 starts the application. Close the older user session if it was open. Look in the message area for Моя учебная служба работает. It is an actual result only when you see it in your own 1C application.

Ctrl+S saves the configuration edit. F7 updates the infobase configuration used by the application. F5 begins a new run. If you see the old text, check those actions and the selected base before changing source at random. Updating a message requires neither customers nor loading a ready-made service.

sections.title: Change the message, not the event
paragraphs: Replace only the quoted text with Проверяю новую версию. Predict the message first, then save, apply and restart. An earlier Nexus note cannot show which version actually ran. Observing the new message in the selected base confirms this small change.

If a closing quote is missing, use the diagnostic to correct the module. An older message does not count as success for the new version. Undo or your saved source provides recovery. The task below asks for two new phrases in order, applying the action you have learned.

practice.title: On your own: start the class
practice.task: In your separate infobase display two messages: Занятие началось first, then Следующий шаг — расчёт. Save, apply and run. Then append “ — проверка” only to the second phrase and verify a new run.
practice.environment: Official installed 1C in a separate training infobase. Nexus shows the lesson and keeps an optional draft; it does not run this program.
practice.externalRoute: Follow the steps labelled by application. The self-report field records your external observation; it is not Nexus verification.

passport.goal: Display two actual messages and verify one change.
passport.start: A separate empty base and its managed application module.
passport.where: Designer for code; Enterprise for observation.
passport.knowledge: Event procedure, Сообщить, string, parentheses, ;, save/F7/F5.
passport.change: Two calls inside one handler; then only the second phrase.
passport.inputs: The specified messages; no user input.
passport.result: Two ordered messages; a changed ending in the second run.
passport.checks: Actual message area, saved module and action record. Nexus keeps a self-report.
passport.errors: Wrong module, duplicate handler, quotes or unapplied version.
passport.recovery: Close the user session, undo your last edit and repeat the sequence.

steps.action: Open the correct empty module. Inside one handler, write two Сообщить calls with the specified messages.
steps.why: So the action has an observable, reproducible result.

steps.action: Ctrl+S → F7 → a new F5; read the messages. Change the second phrase and repeat.
steps.why: So the action has an observable, reproducible result.

criteria: Both messages appear in your own base.
Only the second phrase changes in the second run.
Actual actions are recorded; somebody else’s screenshot is not treated as your execution.
practice.hint: Keep the handler framework. Each message is a separate Сообщить call inside it.

paragraphs: The second experiment changes only the second message. This reference is not evidence of your execution.

selfcheck.feedback: The handler is tied to a platform event.
Quotes and the delimiter belong to the source statement.

selfcheck.prompt: After editing, the old message still appears. What should you check first?
options: Your base, save, F7 and a new run

selfcheck.prompt: Can you freely rename the handler instead of changing its message?
options: No: its name is tied to an event
selfcheck.feedback: Change the string argument, not the event handler identity.
